column1: # Complete quant x KV matrix for every tested model with >=2 GGUF quant files on disk
# (Phase M covered the finalists' {low, canonical, high} sample; this stage runs the rest).
# Construction identical to Phase M: T1 ctx 32768, np 1, -fa on --reasoning-budget 0 -cram 0,
# engine /opt/llama.cpp-dory, KV {f16, q4_0, q8_0} per quant, ordered by screen rank
# (Bolt r2, Spark-X2.6-4B r4, Gemma 4 12B r9, Spark-X2.6-1.7B r12, LFM3-1.7B r13,
# LFM2.5-2.6B r15, MiniCPM-V 4.7 1B r18 TEXT-ONLY, LFM2.5-1.2B r19).
# Excluded: mmproj projectors, MiniCPM5-2B DSpark draft + F16 reference (Phase M notes),
# Spark-X2.5 family (superseded generation, never rostered - completeness audit),
# untested models (classifier set, Flint, Clef, Bonsai, Granite Switch, LFM2.5-24B, LFM3-VL).
# FIT: weights + KV at 32K + ~600 MiB engine overhead must leave >=1024 MiB spare; cells that
# cannot serve record serve_failed with cause (does-not-fit), never a 0 score.
